feedback:
- Category: test
- Severity: medium
- File: server/src/core/model-tier-config-reader.test.ts:119 — The “Git cannot identify its main worktree” test’s expectation conflicts with the Git layout it creates. `git init --separate-git-dir=<metadata> <root>` leaves `<root>/.git` as a gitdir file, and `git worktree list --porcelain` still reports `<root>` as the first (main) worktree. `resolveModelConfigRoot()` therefore returns `root` and reads its `review: "opus"` config, so the asserted `model_config_unreadable`/`inherit` result will fail.
- Suggestion: Change this test to assert that the main checkout’s `opus` value wins, consistent with the linked-worktree requirement. If an unresolvable-main-worktree fallback is intended, construct a genuinely unusable `git worktree list`/main-worktree condition and test that explicitly.

Overall assessment: ship-with-fixes. The implementation appears to meet the requested read-only display, warning, linked-worktree, override, and GET-only API behavior, but the added reader test is expected to fail under normal Git behavior and must be corrected before shipping.

SHIPWRIGHT_VERDICT: revise
